commit_message: Add ADR0156 campaign core state machine
pr_body:
## Summary

Builds the ADR 0156 campaign core on the validated schema slice. Freezes physical model representation separately from runtime/platform identity, enforces model-comparison versus Windows-native/WSL2 runtime-characterization semantics, deterministic sequential schedules, exact Download & Run preflight authorization, bounded pre-measurement retry, non-retried measured failures, exact automatic evidence identity, pause/resume boundaries, and rollback-safe machine-local progress persistence.

Controlled fixture materialization, managed acquisition execution, campaign worker/UI, and final Visual Validation continue on this Draft PR.
